999008199.text: できた！　この薬を藻にかければ……

localizations.en: Done! If we apply this remedy to the seaweed...

999008199.text: やった、成功！　これで船の墓場もへっちゃらっすわ！

localizations.en: Yes! It worked! Now the ship graveyard will be a piece of cake!

999008199.text:
ううむ、素晴らしいな……
錬金術の神秘は何度見ても心が躍る。なぁ千歳

localizations.en: Impressive... The mysteries of alchemy never fail to stir the heart. Wouldn't you agree, Chitose?

999008199.text: はい、す、素晴らしいです
まったくだね、アタシも錬金術ができたら便利なんだが

localizations.en: You can say that again. I wish I could use alchemy too—it'd be so convenient.

999008199.text: え？　イェルカできないの？

localizations.en: Huh? You can't use alchemy, Jelka?

999008199.text:
私たち九偉人のうち、錬金術が使えるように
創られたのはナナからだ

localizations.en: Among us Nine, only Nana and those created after her were made capable of using alchemy.

999008199.text:
アタシやゴゥはそれより前に創られたからね。
錬金術は使えないんだよ。手伝いくらいはできるけどね

localizations.en: Gou and I were created before that, so we can't use alchemy. We can lend a hand with synthesis work, though.

999008199.text: 創られた……というのはどういう意味だ？

アタシらはホムンクルス……錬金術によって
生み出された人造人間なのさ。ヴァレリアもそうだよ

localizations.en: We're homunculi—artificial humans created through alchemy. Same with Valeria.

999008199.text: なんと！？　見た目は普通の人間と変わらんぞ……

localizations.en: What?! But you look no different from ordinary humans...

999008199.text:
中身もそんなに変わらないわよ。
丈夫にできてるくらいで

localizations.en: We're not that different on the inside either. We're just built to be more durable.

999008199.text: ふうむ。よもや錬金術がそれほどの技術だったとは……

localizations.en: Fascinating. To think alchemy had reached such heights...

999008199.text:
ヴァレリアより後に生まれた二人……ヤドヴィガと
キュー蔵も、錬金術を使えるよ

localizations.en: The two created after Valeria—Jadwiga and Quinn—can use alchemy too.

999008199.text:
逆に、一番上の兄と姉は戦闘に特化しすぎていてな。
あまりに危険だからと、今は眠らされている

localizations.en: Our eldest brother and sister, on the other hand, were too specialized for combat. They were deemed too dangerous, so they've been put to sleep.

999008199.text:
うーん……一番上の兄と姉……どんなんだったかな……
思い出せそうで思い出せない……

localizations.en: Hmm... The eldest siblings... What were they like again...? I feel like I'm on the verge of remembering, but I can't quite...

999008199.text: でもなんか確かに、おっかなかったような

localizations.en: Though I do have this vague feeling they were... scary.

999008199.text: 自分で生み出しておいて、勝手な話だな

localizations.en: How selfish—to create them and then cast them aside.

999008199.text:
……父様や母様にはお考えがあるのだ。
子どもとして尽くすのみ

localizations.en: ...Father and Mother have their reasons. As their children, we can only serve them faithfully.

999008199.text:
孝行か。そういう考えはケイウンにも根深いが……
お前たちの親とは、どういった存在なのだ？

localizations.en: Filial piety. Such thinking runs deep in Keiun as well... But what manner of beings are these parents of yours?

999008199.text: パルメ族。歴史を裏で操ってきた存在よ

localizations.en: The Palme. Beings who've manipulated history from the shadows.

999008199.text:
世界の管理者を自称して、ランターナ大陸の
色んな勢力を影で動かしてきた

localizations.en: They call themselves guardians of the world and have been pulling the strings of various factions across the Lantarna continent from behind the scenes.

999008199.text:
アタシの生まれたノーヴァ神聖国でも
パルメ族が介入して、管理していたの

localizations.en: Even in Nova, where I was born, the Palme interfered and controlled things.

999008199.text:
……そのような勢力がおったのか。
あまり虫が好かんな

localizations.en: ...So such a force exists. I don't like the sound of that.

999008199.text:
父様と母様にもちゃんとお考えがある。
いつかその正しさに気付くことになるだろう

localizations.en: Father and Mother have their reasons. One day, you'll come to understand they were right.

999008199.text: ま、正しい部分もあるのは否定しないっすけどー

localizations.en: Well, I won't deny they got some things right, but...

999008199.text: ……私も、正直どっちか正しいかよく分かってない

localizations.en: ...Honestly, I'm not really sure which side is right myself.

999008199.text:
ああ、いや。余が気に食わんのは影からという部分だ。
どうせなら表立って、堂々と支配せんか

localizations.en: Ah, no. What irks me is the 'from the shadows' part. If they're going to rule, why not do it openly and proudly?

999008199.text: ええ、ひっかかるのそこなんだ……
か、鏑矢様は、そういうお方ですから……

localizations.en: L-Lady Kaburaya has always been... like this...

999008199.text:
まあそれは冗談半分として……
自分たちが常に正しいと考えることは危ういな

localizations.en: Well, that was half in jest... But believing oneself to always be right is dangerous.

999008199.text:
誰しも間違うときはある。
それを余に教えてくれたのはお前たちだった

localizations.en: Everyone makes mistakes. You were the ones who taught me that.

999008199.text:
なればこそ、パルメ族とやらに今度は余が
教えてやりたいものだな……人間を舐めるな、と

localizations.en: And so, I'd like to teach these Palme a lesson in return—don't underestimate humanity.
